body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units toward an enemy or objective. One ally within 4 units may move 1 unit in the same general direction.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

rider.title: EXAMPLE — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority after you succeed on an Action: 1–3 one ally gains +1 Defense; 4–5 one ally becomes Rallied; 6+ two allies become Rallied.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
